galleryData.subtitle: Every supported field in one tile (styleguide only)
notes: This item demonstrates optional gallery metadata when there is no dedicated blog or project page.
Notes accept multiline YAML. The modal shows them below the image; on /gallery, social sharing uses this text for meta description when present.
Use `link` as a string or list. Blog/project paths appear in the toolbar; external URLs show under Show details as sources.
